messages:
Alex (AE): Pegasus asked for a Friday POC: 24h soak, sustained 500 QPS, 2k short bursts, p99 <150ms non-streaming, BYOK/HSM, SOC2. Need cost + runbook. Who owns?

Priya (Sales SE): I can run it. Request: sample prompt mix + avg response token size. Plan: smoke -> ramp 0->500 over 25m -> 24h soak -> 90s 2k bursts every 4h. Test rwl-3b and rwl-13b-quant.

Ben (Infra): We'll allocate Dedicated pools in us-west1 and eu-west1. Baseline: 3x A100-eq per region, autoscale +2 for bursts. BYOK+HSM adds ~48h ops and region limits.

Rina (Prod Eng): To help p99, use 13b-quant with async batching (batch_size target 6) and KV prefix caching. Set max_tokens=128 for benchmarks. Non-streaming is good — reduces tail.

Priya (Sales SE): Load runner: we'll use regional k6 runners. Example steady-state snippet will be in runbook. Will post manifests and a coordination script by Thu EOD.

sec-bot: Security SQ: https://redwood.security/pegasus-sq. Needed: SOC2 PDF, KMS type, BYOK/HSM appendix, data residency, access control matrix. @Alex please upload NDA + completed SQ.

Ben (Infra): Preliminary 24h cost (multi-region): infra ~$3k, runners/network ~$300, ops ~$600, model compute ~ $1k => est total ~$5k. Final after exact token sizes.

Alex (AE): I'll get NDA + prompt pack to Priya by Thu EOD. Locking run for Fri 09:00 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
internal_note: Small sales POC coordination thread for multi-region 24h soak with HSM/BYOK and cost estimate. Short Slack-style messages.
